```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

# Security Model:
# This workflow is triggered by a slash command via workflow_dispatch.
# It runs in the context of the base repository (airbytehq/airbyte).
# For fork PRs, we checkout the PR head ref but run the workflow in the base repo context.
# This is safe because:
# 1. The workflow runs with the base repo's permissions.
# 2. We do not execute arbitrary code from the fork PR.
# 3. We only read file contents and pass them to the Devin AI service.
# 4. The Devin AI service is configured to only read documentation files.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'PR number to review (e.g., 123)'
        required: false
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
      comment_id:
        description: 'Comment ID of the slash command (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Validate PR input
        id: validate
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]; then
            echo "PR input is missing. Please provide a PR number."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "pr_number=${{ inputs.pr }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post error comment if validation fails
        if: failure() && steps.validate.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            :x: **AI Docs Review Failed**
            
            Could not validate PR input. Please ensure the PR number is correct.
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Checkout PR head
        if: success()
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Get changed files
        if: success()
        id: changed-files
        run: |
          # Use GitHub API to get changed files with pagination
          # This handles PRs with >30 changed files
          files=$(gh api --paginate /repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files \
            --jq '.[].filename' | grep -E '\.(md|rst|txt|yml|yaml|json|py|java|go|ts|js|tsx|jsx)$' || true)
          
          if [ -z "$files" ]; then
            echo "No documentation files changed."
            echo "has_docs_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_docs_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "$files" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post start comment
        if: success() && steps.changed-files.outputs.has_docs_changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            :hourglass_flowing_sand: **AI Docs Review Started**
            
            Reviewing documentation changes in this PR...
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Post skip comment
        if: success() && steps.changed-files.outputs.has_docs_changes == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            :white_check_mark: **AI Docs Review Skipped**
            
            No documentation files were changed in this PR.
          token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Run Devin AI Docs Review
        if: success() && steps.changed-files.outputs.has_docs_changes == 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          prompt-text: |
            Please review the documentation changes in this PR.
            
            Changed files:
            ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.files }}
            
            Focus on:
            1. Clarity and correctness of documentation
            2. Consistency with existing documentation style
            3. Completeness of documentation for new features
            4. Accuracy of code examples
          start-message: ":robot: **AI Docs Review in Progress**"
```
